newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Feb 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Feb 20.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Thursday, as reported by Kyodo News Agency.
-- China's paramount leader Deng Xiaoping feared dead.
-- Democratic Party, Social Democratic Party, and the small Sakigake party to discuss joining forces in Diet.
-- China allows defector Hwang to go to South Korea.
-- Government will use public funds to buy up land held as collateral.
-- China starts talks with South Korea on defector Hwang's departure from Beijing.
-- Upper House legislator Tatsuo Tomobe indicted on charges of fraud.
-- Peruvian police failed to respond to information on attack on Japanese envoy's house by Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA) rebels.
